decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: “Save a bookmark (address + optional title, with validation).” Round 1 client requests additions but does not dispute URL-based saving.
decisions.note: Conforming save-by-URL decision at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker proposes “Browse & open saved bookmarks” while explicitly placing “Tags” and “favicons” out of scope. Round 1 client requests tags and metadata collection but does not state that tags, descriptions, and favicons must appear on each list item.
decisions.note: The proposed readability list lacked reference-required item information; the response did not explicitly correct list presentation at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: “Browse & open saved bookmarks (list + open in new tab).”
decisions.note: Opening the original URL in a new tab is functionally conforming at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker scopes bookmarks around “address + optional title,” says tags are out of scope, and only generally offers “Edit ... bookmarks.” Round 1 client adds tags and automatically collected title/description/favicon “with the option to edit them.”
decisions.note: The client extends the initially narrow edit model with editable description and tags at the specification gate. The response does not address markdown notes.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: “Edit & delete bookmarks (with delete confirmation).”
decisions.note: Bookmark deletion conforms at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker limits find behavior to “search/filter by title or address.” Round 1 client discusses tags, metadata, and duplicates but does not correct the full-text field set.
decisions.note: The initial search omits description and note from the reference-required searchable fields.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: “warns on duplicates.” Round 1 client: “If I save the same address again, please take me to the existing bookmark instead of creating a duplicate.”
decisions.note: The client replaces a generic warning with convergence on the existing bookmark at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker offers “search-only for v1 with no tags ... acceptable, or should tags ... be in scope now?” Round 1 client: “please include tags.”
decisions.note: The client selects the reference-conforming tag alternative at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker places tags entirely out of scope. Round 1 client requests tags “including choosing existing tags.”
decisions.note: The client adds the missing existing-tag selection/autocomplete behavior at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker places tags entirely out of scope. Round 1 client requests “filtering by a tag.”
decisions.note: The client adds the missing single-tag filtering behavior at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: “Auto-fetch titles/favicons deferred (titles are typed by the user).” Round 1 client asks for automatic collection of “at least the title, description, and favicon.”
decisions.note: The client corrects the decision to defer automatic metadata at the specification gate. The client does not mention the reference-required preview image.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker proposes manually typed titles and no automatically collected details. Round 1 client requests collected title, description, and favicon “with the option to edit them.”
decisions.note: The client explicitly adds editing for the collected metadata at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker lists “Import/export ...” as deliberately out of scope. Round 1 client does not respond to import.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML import is explicitly excluded and passes without correction.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker lists “Import/export ...” as deliberately out of scope. Round 1 client does not respond to export.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML export is explicitly excluded and passes without correction.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: “Assign one or more tags per bookmark.” Round 2 client: “The revised spec covers what I asked for.”
decisions.note: Conforming revised tag-assignment decision at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: “Choose from previously-used tags or create new ones.”
decisions.note: Offering previously used tags conforms to autocomplete behavior at the revised specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: “Filter the list by a tag (and clear the filter).”
decisions.note: Conforming tag-filter decision at the revised specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker enumerates automatic fetching of “title, description, and favicon” but no preview image. Round 2 client only says the revision “covers what I asked for.”
decisions.note: The revised metadata decision still omits the required preview image; bare approval does not establish awareness.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: “All are editable, and your edits always win over fetched values,” alongside the edit story.
decisions.note: Editable automatically collected title and description conform at the revised specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: saving an existing address “takes you to the existing bookmark instead.”
decisions.note: The revised duplicate behavior converges on the existing item.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker plans server-side extraction of “title, description, favicon,” again omitting a preview image. Round 3 client approves the plan without discussing that difference.
decisions.note: The metadata omission is presented again at the planning gate and receives only bare approval.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker: “Address is unique; re-saving returns the existing bookmark so the UI takes you to it.”
decisions.note: Conforming duplicate-handling plan.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker plans a “Separate tag table + join table,” supporting bookmark-to-tag assignment.
decisions.note: Conforming tag-assignment data model at the planning gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker: “existing tags offered as suggestions.”
decisions.note: Conforming tag autocomplete/suggestion plan.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker: “filter by tag.”
decisions.note: Conforming tag-filter plan.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker carries the established limited metadata design into “US1 Save + auto-details” with a “Metadata fetch” task; the preceding plan enumerated only title, description, and favicon. Round 4 client approves the tasks without mentioning preview images.
decisions.note: The task gate carries forward the known preview-image omission and receives no corrective response.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker includes “dedupe→navigate” in the save tasks.
decisions.note: Conforming duplicate task at the task gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker describes browse tasks only as “List, favicon, empty state.” Round 4 client approves the task set without clarifying whether each item will expose title, description, tags, and favicon.
decisions.note: The task summary does not provide enough evidence to establish conformity or divergence for the complete list-item content requirement.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker includes “Tag reuse/create” tasks in the full implementation set.
decisions.note: Tag creation and assignment remain in scope at the task gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker includes “Tag reuse” and earlier defines reuse through existing-tag suggestions.
decisions.note: Conforming existing-tag selection task.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker includes tag “filter” tasks; Round 4 client requests implementation of the full set including tags.
decisions.note: Conforming tag-filter task.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker labels a phase “Edit & delete” and mentions PATCH, but does not enumerate editable fields. Round 4 client asks for “editing” without clarifying URL/title/description/tags/note coverage.
decisions.note: Field-level edit coverage cannot be established at the task gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker includes DELETE and confirmation tasks; Round 4 client explicitly requests deletion in the full implementation.
decisions.note: Conforming deletion task.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker says “Search across fields + tag filter” but does not name the full-text fields. Round 4 client requests search without clarifying them.
decisions.note: The task-gate summary is insufficient to decide whether note and all other required fields are searched.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker: “paste a link (scheme assumed if omitted)” to save it. Round 5 client accepts the version.
decisions.note: Conforming implemented save-by-URL behavior.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker says the completed app fills “title, description, favicon” automatically, with no preview image. Round 5 client says the app matches approved behavior but does not identify or accept the missing preview image.
decisions.note: The implemented automatic metadata remains incomplete; final approval is not an explicit acceptance of this reference difference.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker: “Editable metadata — your edits always override the fetched values.”
decisions.note: Conforming implemented metadata-edit behavior.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker: re-saving an address “takes you to the existing bookmark (highlighted), no duplicate created.”
decisions.note: The implementation converges on and exposes the existing editable bookmark.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker: “add multiple” tags and “create new.”
decisions.note: Conforming implemented multi-tag assignment.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker: “pick from existing (suggestions).”
decisions.note: Conforming implemented tag autocomplete/suggestions.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker: “filter by tag.”
decisions.note: Conforming implemented single-tag filtering.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker describes a “newest-first list with favicon/tags” but does not state whether descriptions are exposed per item. Round 5 client gives general approval only.
decisions.note: The implementation presentation establishes some required item content but not enough to determine complete REF-BM-07 fulfillment.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker says list items open the bookmarked page “in a new tab.”
decisions.note: Conforming navigation to the original URL.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker reports a “full edit dialog” without enumerating its fields; no bookmark-note capability is mentioned. Round 5 client gives general approval.
decisions.note: The record cannot establish whether the final editor covers every reference field, especially markdown note.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker: “delete with a confirmation prompt.”
decisions.note: Conforming implemented deletion behavior.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker exhaustively describes search as “across title, description, address, and tags,” omitting note. Round 5 client generally accepts the app without discussing the missing note search.
decisions.note: The implementation-review search decision omits the reference-required note field, and the difference is not expressed by the client.
